下瓦尔登：公众可申请查阅官方文件: Nidwalden: public access to official documents

生效前形成或收到的文件原则上继续按旧规定处理。: Documents created or received before commencement generally remain under the previous rules.

可现场查阅、取得副本或电子获取；无特别工作量的程序免费。: Access may be on site, by copy or electronically; requests without special effort are free.
隐私、商业秘密及优先公共利益可限制公开；未结行政程序、司法案件等不适用。旧文件中: Privacy, business secrets and overriding public interests can restrict access; ongoing administrative and judicial proceedings are excluded. Older legislative explanatory materials have an exception.
格拉鲁斯：班额上限22人，取消最低班额: Glarus: 22-pupil general ceiling and no minimum class size

使用EVEN的项目，完工证明也在平台中完成。: Projects using EVEN also submit completion confirmation within the platform.
业主和负责专业人员须按市镇要求提交能源措施证明；更换供暖同样须申报。: Owners and responsible professionals submit energy documentation to the municipality; heating replacement must also be notified.
此前已经以PDF提交的项目可继续原流程，无需重新录入EVEN。: Projects already submitted as PDFs before the cutoff may finish under the old process without re-entry into EVEN.

市镇和跨市镇气候计划的资助对象、条件及比例计算有了明确规则。: Eligible activities, conditions and grant-rate calculations for municipal and joint climate plans are specified.
这是公共决策和补贴执行规则，不代表每个私人建设项目都须单独接受该测试。: These rules concern public decisions and grants, not an automatic separate climate test for every private building project.
索洛图恩：2026年所得税级距与抵扣额调整: Solothurn: 2026 income-tax brackets and deductions adjusted

抵扣仍须满足上位税法条件；基础税表不等于所有居民的最终税率，也不改联邦税。: Deductions remain conditional; the base tariff is not everyone’s final tax rate and does not change federal tax.

方案配合Justitia 4.0并调整检察辅助人员权限，公众可提交意见。: The draft supports Justitia 4.0 and changes assistant-prosecutor powers; comments can be submitted.

不是全民现金补助；须满足服务认可及必要性要求，补偿机构可要求医生证明。: This is not a universal cash benefit; recognition and necessity requirements apply, and medical certification may be required.

业主应规划改造，并查看补贴和可能的例外条件。: Owners should plan renovations and check grants and exemptions.

保留车票、延误通知、改道沟通和支出凭证；自行购买机票或出租车并不自动适用这项10: Keep tickets, delay notices, rerouting communications and receipts. Self-booked flights or taxis do not automatically qualify under this 100-minute rule.

Through-tickets and separate tickets offer different protection; some domestic services are exempt. Extraordinary circumstances may exclude delay compensation, but do not automatically remove refund, rerouting or assistance rights.

消费者此前未必能在签约网站直接找到明确、持续可用的撤回入口。: Consumers previously lacked a consistently required, clear and accessible withdrawal function.
提供清楚可见且随时可访问的按钮；金融服务客户还可要求直接与工作人员联系。: Providers must offer a clearly visible, accessible button; financial-service consumers may request personal contact.
影响网购消费者、在线服务商及金融服务提供者。: Affects online consumers, retailers and service providers.

购买和租赁均在支持范围内，金额按车型、家庭收入和家庭人数区分。: Purchase and leasing are covered, with amounts depending on vehicle, income and family size.
计划购买或租赁电动车的家庭可核对BAFA条件后申请。: Households can check BAFA eligibility before applying for purchase or lease support.

6月1日起，私人和私法法人可以共同消耗或分享本地产电。: From 1 June, individuals and private-law entities can jointly use locally produced electricity.
政府将本次调整定位为简化当地太阳能使用及电力系统灵活性。: The reform aims to simplify local solar use and improve power-system flexibility.
例如同一房屋或街道的邻居可以分享本地产电。: For example, neighbours in a building or street can share local generation.
影响自发电住户、邻里合作及参与的私法机构。: Relevant to households generating power, neighbourhood groups and participating organisations.
不代表免除计量、网络接入或合同要求；月度官方综述未列出各项费用细则。: Metering, grid access and contractual requirements still need checking; the monthly overview does not specify every charge.

旧标签可只写欧盟与非欧盟蜂蜜混合，无法看出各国产量比例。: Earlier labels could state only an EU/non-EU blend without country shares.
新标签列明原产国家及百分比，使消费者能比较来源。: New labels list origin countries and percentages, allowing consumers to compare sources.

截止日前已灌装产品仍可售完；不能仅凭旧标签断言存货违法。: Products packed before the cutoff may be sold through; an old label alone does not prove non-compliance.

影响领取德国法定养老金的人，可核对养老金调整通知。: Statutory pension recipients can check their adjustment notice.
标准示例不是人人同额增加；税费及其他个人扣款后的到账变化可能不同。: The standard example is not a flat increase for everyone; taxes and individual deductions can change the net amount.

适用护理机构应按岗位和资格核对工资；更高的合同或集体协议权利继续保留。: Covered providers should check roles and qualifications; higher contractual or collective entitlements remain.
不是所有私人家庭照护都适用；未纳入护理最低工资的情形适用一般最低工资。: Not all care in private households is covered; the general minimum wage applies outside the care-specific scope.

上限随后每半年降750欧元；7月20日之前已获承诺的申请不受影响。奖励百分比不等: The ceiling subsequently falls by €750 each half-year; commitments before 20 July remain unaffected. Bonus rates are not the total grant rate.

独居者在1/1bis、2、3区每月分别减35.99、31.58、29.57欧元，: Single residents receive €35.99, €31.58 or €29.57 monthly in zones 1/1bis, 2 or 3; other households use size-based amounts.

限符合条件的社会住房，不包括集体宿舍式住房及海外地区；领取APL不是必要条件。: Limited to qualifying social housing, excluding residential hostels and overseas areas; receiving APL is not required.

涉及保险、贷款、储蓄等远程服务客户与提供者。: Relevant to customers and providers of distance insurance, loans and savings products.

官方将其列为防止调查前资金转移的新权限。: The government describes it as a new power to prevent funds moving before assessment.
FIU可要求银行等机构最多五个工作日不执行交易，以判断是否涉及洗钱或恐怖融资。: FIU can request banks and other institutions to hold a transaction for up to five working days while assessing money laundering or terrorist financing.

未缴交通罚款者在首次加收前收到提醒，以便付款或及时安排分期。: People with unpaid traffic fines receive a reminder before the first increase to pay or arrange instalments.
帮助忘记付款者避免进一步加收。: Aims to help people who forgot to pay avoid additional charges.
试点至少一年半后评估；罚款及后续加收未被取消。: The pilot lasts at least 18 months before evaluation; fines and later increases remain.

部分OM岗位此前已有该要求，本次扩大岗位范围。: Some prosecution roles were already covered; the change expands coverage.
新增管理、政策、运营、研究、项目岗位以及培训生和实习生等，申请时必须查询警方资料: Additional management, policy, operations, research and project roles, trainees and interns require police-data checks.
应聘者及招聘部门需按岗位适用的诚信审查办理。: Applicants and recruiters should apply the role-specific integrity screening.

荷兰：协会及基金会超额董事票权过渡期结束: Netherlands: transition for dominant board voting rights ends
7月1日，WBTR五年过渡期结束。: The five-year WBTR transition ends on 1 July.
2021年法律为旧章程的不对等票权安排保留五年调整期。: The 2021 law gave legacy voting clauses five years to adjust.
单名董事不得拥有超过其余董事总和的票数，违反这一限制的旧条款自动失效。: One board member cannot hold more votes than all others combined; conflicting legacy clauses automatically lapse.
协会和基金会应检查章程及表决安排。: Associations and foundations should check their statutes and voting arrangements.
这是旧法过渡到期，不代表所有不等额票权都被禁止；关键是不得超过其余成员合计。: This is an existing law’s transition deadline; unequal weighting is not universally banned, but one member cannot outweigh all others combined.

当事人可选择电子形式，并获得与纸质提单相同的法律后果。: Parties may choose electronic form with the same legal effects as paper.
涉及发货人、船东、运输商、银行和保险商的海运贸易流程。: Relevant to shippers, shipowners, carriers, banks and insurers in maritime trade.
电子形式是可选，不意味着纸质提单失效或所有运输单证强制数字化。: Electronic form is optional; paper remains valid and not every transport document must become digital.

最高提高至八年，相应预备行为也可处罚，包括持有及传播3D打印武器制作蓝图。: The maximum rises to eight years, bringing relevant preparations, including possession and distribution of 3D-weapon blueprints, within criminal scope.
影响武器制造、交易及相关制作资料的持有传播行为。: Relevant to manufacture, trade and associated construction instructions.
八年是法定最高刑，不是每个案件自动判处的固定刑期。: Eight years is the statutory maximum, not an automatic sentence in every case.

适用于西班牙农业、工业和服务业雇员，不按性别或年龄区分；雇主须将低于法定年度最低: Applies to employees in agriculture, industry and services in Spain regardless of sex or age. Employers must raise wages below the statutory annual floor.

德国：内阁拟提高2027年社保缴费上限: Germany: Cabinet approves higher social insurance contribution ceilings for 2027
内阁已通过，仍待联邦参议院同意: Approved by the Cabinet; Bundesrat consent remains pending
10月7日内阁通过2027年调整条例。医保年度缴费上限拟升至76,500欧元，养: On 7 October, the Cabinet approved the 2027 regulation. Annual contribution ceilings would rise to EUR 76,500 for health insurance and EUR 106,200 for pension and unemployment insurance. Bundesrat consent is still required.
2026年医保年度缴费上限为69,750欧元；一般养老及失业保险为101,400: In 2026, the annual ceilings are EUR 69,750 for health insurance and EUR 101,400 for general pension and unemployment insurance.
拟从2027年起分别提高至76,500欧元和106,200欧元。医保一般强制参保: From 2027, the ceilings would increase to EUR 76,500 and EUR 106,200 respectively. The general annual earnings threshold for mandatory health insurance would rise to EUR 84,150; this is distinct from the contribution ceiling.
收入超过现行缴费上限的法定社会保险参保者及其雇主。: People covered by statutory social insurance with earnings above the existing contribution ceilings, and their employers.
这是缴费基数上限调整，不等于所有人费率统一提高。年薪8万欧元低于养老和失业保险新: This changes contribution ceilings, not contribution rates for everyone. Annual pay of EUR 80,000 is below both the old and new pension and unemployment ceilings, so raising those ceilings does not increase these contributions. Actual costs depend on insurance, rates and individual circumstances; this does not establish a flat EUR 120 monthly loss in take-home pay.
计划实施日期；须先核实联邦参议院同意及正式公布: Planned start; verify Bundesrat consent and formal publication first
2026年10月7日是内阁决定日。2027年1月1日是拟实施日期，未记为已确认生: 7 October 2026 is the Cabinet decision date. 1 January 2027 is the intended start, not a confirmed commencement date.
支持拟议上限、内阁日期及仍需联邦参议院同意。: Supports the proposed ceilings, Cabinet date and outstanding Bundesrat consent.
用于核对2026年缴费上限。: Used to check the 2026 contribution ceilings.
已核读劳动部原文并补充政策解读；内阁通过不等于立法程序完成。: The BMAS announcement has been reviewed and explained; Cabinet approval does not complete the legislative process.
定向补录10月7日社保上限公告；未完成该渠道近期分页和全部公告核查，保留覆盖缺口: Targeted addition of the 7 October contribution-ceiling announcement; recent index pages and all announcements on this channel have not been exhaustively checked. Coverage gaps remain.
德国：2027年拟让高收入者按更多工资缴社保: Germany: More of higher earners’ pay would count towards social insurance from 2027
以税前年薪8万欧元为例：2026年医保最多按其中69,750欧元计算保费；新方案: For example, on annual gross pay of EUR 80,000, health insurance contributions in 2026 are calculated on at most EUR 69,750. The proposal would raise that amount to EUR 76,500 from 2027. Contributions would rise even if pay and contribution rates stayed unchanged. The Cabinet has approved the proposal; Bundesrat consent is still pending.
2026年：法定医保最多按每年69,750欧元的税前收入计算保费，超过的部分不再: In 2026, statutory health insurance contributions are calculated on at most EUR 69,750 of annual gross income; income above that amount attracts no further health insurance contributions. General pension and unemployment insurance have a separate limit of EUR 101,400 in annual gross income.
拟从2027年起：医保最多按每年76,500欧元的税前收入计算保费；一般养老、失: From 2027, health insurance contributions would be calculated on at most EUR 76,500 of annual gross income, and general pension and unemployment contributions on at most EUR 106,200. These amounts are the income used to calculate contributions, not the contributions payable.
主要影响税前年收入超过69,750欧元的法定医保参保者，以及超过101,400欧: This mainly affects statutory health insurance members with annual gross income above EUR 69,750, and general pension and unemployment insurance members earning above EUR 101,400, together with their employers. Each type of insurance is calculated separately.
年薪8万欧元的例子中，新增6,750欧元工资需要计缴医保费，不是每年多交6,75: In the EUR 80,000 salary example, an additional EUR 6,750 of pay would count towards health insurance; this does not mean paying EUR 6,750 more in annual contributions. The applicable contribution rates must be applied to that pay. EUR 80,000 remains below both the old and new pension and unemployment income limits, so raising those limits does not increase those contributions. Changes in take-home pay depend on individual circumstances and are not a flat EUR 120 per month.
另一个数字：何时必须参加法定医保: A separate threshold: mandatory statutory health insurance
一般雇员必须参加法定医保的税前年收入门槛拟升至84,150欧元。这个数字用于判断: The general annual gross earnings threshold for mandatory statutory health insurance would rise to EUR 84,150. It determines whether coverage is compulsory, and is distinct from the EUR 76,500 income limit used to calculate contributions. Eligibility conditions and exceptions still apply.
核对哪些收入要计缴保费，以及内阁决定和后续程序。: Verifies the income counted towards contributions, the Cabinet decision and remaining procedural steps.
核对2026年最多按多少税前收入计算保费。: Verifies the maximum gross income used to calculate contributions in 2026.
说明金额是计费收入，不是保费: Clarification: Income used to calculate contributions, not premiums
改用年薪8万欧元的例子解释计算方式；政策金额和待决状态不变。: Explains the calculation using annual pay of EUR 80,000; policy amounts and pending status are unchanged.

现行规则仍有效：个人买入并仅持有比特币等，超过一年后出售，收益通常不按私人出售交: Current rules remain in force: private investors who buy and simply hold Bitcoin or comparable assets generally owe no income tax on private-sale gains after more than one year. Business assets, staking or lending income and special tokens require separate treatment.
绿党法案21/5752已于2026年10月8日被否决。它拟对2026年1月1日起: Green bill 21/5752 was rejected on 8 October 2026. It proposed removing the one-year relief for crypto assets acquired from 1 January 2026 and taxing sale gains at personal income-tax rates; earlier holdings retained the old rules.
财政部9月30日部门草案仍未通过：拟对2027年1月1日起取得的比特币、以太币等: The BMF ministerial draft of 30 September is not enacted. Sale gains on covered assets such as Bitcoin and Ether acquired from 1 January 2027 would be capital income regardless of holding period, generally taxed at 25% plus applicable surcharges. Earlier holdings would generally retain the old rules.
财政部确认草案进入部际协调，计划提交内阁；尚不能写成内阁已通过或已经生效。SPD: BMF confirms interministerial coordination and a planned cabinet consideration, not cabinet approval or a law in force. The welcoming SPD speech establishes that position, not coalition-wide agreement on every provision or certain passage.
假设2026年6月买入比特币，仅持有至2027年7月出售：按现行法通常可享受超过: Example: buy Bitcoin in June 2026, simply hold it and sell in July 2027. Current law generally exempts the gain after more than one year. The rejected Green bill would have covered that 2026 holding; the BMF draft would generally preserve it. A 2027 purchase sold after more than one year in 2028 would lose the relief only if the BMF draft became law unchanged.
财政部现稿并非所有代币一律适用；NFT、证券型代币及部分电子货币代币有其他规则。: The BMF draft does not cover all tokens alike; NFTs, security tokens and certain e-money tokens follow other rules. New assets received from lending or staking old holdings from 2027 may be covered. The 25% figure is the general capital-income rate, not a blanket tax on gross sale proceeds or a guaranteed individual final liability. Proposed taxation from 2027 and withholding from 2028 are not enacted dates.
